ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL(EUSFA_Document_Type__c, "Store Specific"), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(EUSFA_Route_Sales_Geo__c)), AND( ISBLANK(EUSFA_Customer__c), ISBLANK(EUSFA_Key_Account__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(EUSFA_PS_L3_Bevs_Value_Segmt__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(EUSFA_PS_L3_Snack_Value_Segmt__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(EUSFA_L2_Subchannel__c)) )
) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For "Store Specific" document type, Any one of the Customer Hierarchy fields must be populated and Route Sales Geo must be blank.
